name: smart-factory-production-scheduler
description: Smart Factory Production Scheduler: a React frontend, an Express/MySQL backend and a C++ engine in one repository. See README.md.

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
